Privacy policy

How Event Horizon handles information.

Review draft · 25 November 2026

Review draft. Contact details and remaining privacy disclosures must be completed before publication.

Who we are

Event Horizon is the publishing name of João Seixas. This policy covers this website and our apps that link to it. For privacy questions or requests, use our support contact.

Information and services

On your devices. Our apps store the information you enter or import, your preferences and saved activity on your devices. Some features exchange data with your paired devices. Device backups are controlled by your platform settings. We do not receive this local information unless you choose to send it to us.

Connected services. When you use a feature that connects to an external service or device, it receives the information needed to fulfil your request, such as your IP address, requested content and any credentials you provide. Independent services handle that information under their own privacy policies. Review information before sharing it.

This website. We do not add advertising, analytics or tracking cookies. Our planned host, GitHub Pages, logs visitor IP addresses for security. See GitHub’s privacy statement.

Contacting us. We receive your email address, message and any attachments through our email provider and use them to handle your request. This is based on our legitimate interest in providing support, or on performing our agreement with you or complying with a legal obligation where applicable. Please do not send passwords, access tokens or unnecessary sensitive information.

Storage and retention

Local data remains until removed through the app or device controls, or replaced or cleared by the app. Uninstalling an app may not remove information in device secure storage, backups or copies you have shared.

We keep support correspondence only for handling your request, necessary follow-up and applicable legal obligations. External services control their own retention. We do not sell personal information or use support messages for advertising.

Your rights

Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability of information we hold, or object to processing based on legitimate interests. Where consent is the basis, you may withdraw it. Contact us through support. We cannot remotely retrieve or erase records held only on your devices or by an independent service.

You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

Updates

We will update this policy when our practices change, show the effective date and communicate material changes appropriately.
